# M'Caravane Kelibia

> Tourist activity operator in Kélibia, Tunisia, offering quad excursions, camel
> and horse rides, and guided city and museum tours. Meeting point at Hotel
> Kelibia Beach. Service in French, English and Italian.

## Activities

- [Quad excursion]({{SITE_URL}}/en/quad-biking-kelibia): guided ride over the dunes, coastal trails and pine forest of Kélibia; one or two hours, briefing, helmet, guide, water and a souvenir photo included, no experience needed.
- [Camel ride]({{SITE_URL}}/en/camel-ride-kelibia): a caravan along El Mansoura beach at sunrise or sunset; thirty minutes or one hour, on calm animals suited to families, with mint tea and photos included.
- [Horse ride]({{SITE_URL}}/en/horse-riding-kelibia): the same shoreline at El Mansoura on horseback; thirty minutes or one hour, with longer routes for confident riders, guide and helmet included.
- [City and museum tour]({{SITE_URL}}/en/kelibia-city-museum-tour): the Byzantine Fort, the old harbour and the museum's Punic and Roman collections with a guide; three hours or a half day, entrance fees and local transport included, Kerkouane optional.
- [All activities]({{SITE_URL}}/en/activities): the four experiences side by side; two or more can be combined into one day.

## Practical information

- Meeting point: Hotel Kelibia Beach, Kélibia, Tunisia
- Languages: French, English, Italian
- Booking: WhatsApp +216 25 434 499
- Email: hello@mcaravane.tn
- All experiences are guided, insured and beginner-friendly, and run in small groups with local guides.
- Prices are not published on the site; they are quoted over WhatsApp.

## Languages

This site is available in [French]({{SITE_URL}}/fr), [English]({{SITE_URL}}/en)
and [Italian]({{SITE_URL}}/it). Every page exists in all three, on its own
localised URL — for example the quad excursion is
[/fr/quad-kelibia]({{SITE_URL}}/fr/quad-kelibia),
[/en/quad-biking-kelibia]({{SITE_URL}}/en/quad-biking-kelibia) and
[/it/escursione-quad-kelibia]({{SITE_URL}}/it/escursione-quad-kelibia).
